project.name: MP3 Alarm Clock
project.summary: A desktop alarm clock that plays an MP3 or your own recorded voice at a scheduled time, keeps the computer awake and wakes it from sleep, with family schedules and a phone remote. One Python file, macOS, Windows and Linux.
project.availability: Free and open source under the MIT licence.
project.privacy: Alarms, recordings and logs live in the folder next to the app. The phone remote works on the home Wi-Fi only.
